title: The Lancashire Creamery Farm Shop Raspberry Custard 100ml Shortfill
description: The Lancashire Creamery’s Raspberry Custard offers a luxurious e-liquid experience that brings together the tangy sweetness of ripe Raspberries with the silky smoothness of rich, velvety Custard. The Raspberry introduces a burst of tart, juicy flavour that cuts through the creamy, indulgent base, striking a perfect balance between sweet and sharp. This comforting dessert-inspired vape offers a deeply satisfying finish, perfect for those who enjoy a refined and well-rounded dessert-inspired blend. With a 70% VG / 30% PG formulation, this high-VG e-liquid is designed for sub-ohm vaping, making it ideal for high-powered vape kits, mods, sub-ohm tanks and low-resistance coils. The thick VG content ensures dense vapour production, while delivering consistently rich flavour. As a 100ml shortfill, this nicotine-free e-liquid leaves room for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to customise your strength. Adding two 18mg nic shots creates 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. The Lancashire Creamery is a UK-based e-liquid brand known for crafting rich, indulgent dessert flavours. Their shortfill collection blends classic bakery, custard, and milkshake profiles, delivering smooth, full-bodied vapes for those who enjoy creamy, sweet treats.
